title: Grothendieck support poset conjecture
statement: Let $w\in S_n$, and let $\operatorname{supp}(\mathfrak{G}_w)$ be the set of exponent vectors of the nonzero terms of the Grothendieck polynomial $\mathfrak{G}_w$. For $\alpha,\beta\in\mathbb{Z}^n$, write $\alpha\leq\beta$ when $\alpha_i\leq\beta_i$ for every $i\in[n]$; write $\alpha<\beta$ for strict componentwise comparison. **Grothendieck support poset conjecture.** If $\alpha\in\operatorname{supp}(\mathfrak{G}_w)$ and $|\alpha|<\deg\mathfrak{G}_w$, then there exists $\beta\in\operatorname{supp}(\mathfrak{G}_w)$ with $\alpha<\beta$. The paper proves this for fireworks permutations, but the assertion for arbitrary permutations remains open.
source_name: Karola Mészáros, Linus Setiabrata and Avery St. Dizier, “On the support of Grothendieck polynomials”, arXiv:2201.09452 (2022).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.09452

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of January 2022).
